ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Name two herbivores in the example diagram of a food web.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram shows the label "grass" at the top. Arrows point from grass to "grasshopper" and from grass to "deer". Other arrows include grasshopper to frog, frog to cobra, cobra to tiger, and deer to tiger. Reasoning: In a food web, an arrow from a plant to an animal indicates that the animal eats the plant. Since both grasshopper and deer receive arrows from grass, they are the herbivores shown.
